race.description: Dowling View Equine Centre Mdn Plate
race.comment: GOLD BIJOUX (9) is a filly by Stay Inside on debut for the McEvoy yard who has looked good at the jumpouts. Drawn the pole and can measure up. GAS STATION ROSE (8) resumes having run a good second on debut at Pakenham behind a smart one. Since spelled, she can be an improver this time around. JE SUIS BEYONCE (10) stepped out for her debut over 1000m at Pakenham back on April 23 and finished fourth, beaten 0.8 lengths. Open to improvement and can feature. MR SAPPHIRE (2) resuming after four-and-a-half months break and was in the money on debut. Has had the benefit of a trial and is a place chance again.
